presentation.summary: Draws the SRC and LFO pages of the SRC machines that describe their own, gives the render an event for machines that make or take a track's sound, and from 1.2 lets a machine have up to seven more SRC values on a second page, so several machine mods combine. irpina's Machine Pages 1.2, ported to run on Core 2.1. On its own, and for machines that do not describe a page, it changes nothing the unit does.
